# Aperture light: exposure, contrast, tone, white balance, colour

- Kind: `editor`
- Category: `photo`
- Slug: `photo/light`

## Summary

The Basic panel adjustment layers: exposure, brightness/contrast, highlights/shadows/whites/blacks, white balance and vibrance/saturation.

## Details

### Layer type `exposure` (Exposure; panel Basic)
- `ev` (Exposure (EV)): -5 to 5, default 0
- `offset` (Offset): -0.5 to 0.5, default 0
- `gamma` (Gamma): 0.1 to 10, default 1
### Layer type `brightnessContrast` (Brightness / contrast; panel Basic)
- `brightness` (Brightness): -100 to 100, default 0
- `contrast` (Contrast): -100 to 100, default 0
### Layer type `tone` (Tone; panel Basic)
- `highlights` (Highlights): -100 to 100, default 0
- `shadows` (Shadows): -100 to 100, default 0
- `whites` (Whites): -100 to 100, default 0
- `blacks` (Blacks): -100 to 100, default 0
### Layer type `whiteBalance` (White balance; panel Basic)
- `temperature` (Temperature): -100 to 100, default 0
- `tint` (Tint): -100 to 100, default 0
### Layer type `vibranceSaturation` (Vibrance / saturation; panel Basic)
- `vibrance` (Vibrance): -100 to 100, default 0
- `saturation` (Saturation): -100 to 100, default 0
Every adjustment layer also has opacity 0–1, blend normal/luminosity/color, enabled, an optional name and an optional mask. Percent-style values (-100 to 100) are 0 when unchanged.
